event: Cael Vorn has carried this for seven years: an unfinished thing at the back of every other.
Seven years ago, at twenty-nine and over-confident, he first entered the dungeon.
The Gullet impressed him; he had not expected that.
In the Warrens the passages shifted, and he heard something moving in the wall.
He turned back, meaning to return better prepared, and did not.
For seven years he built the preparation: rope, chalk, every account of the place.
He followed every report, but did not account for the damage sequence.
The camp is a settlement now: three effects boxes, a Guild man with forms, a chalk scoreboard.
Osren, heavier now, looks up: "Cael Vorn. Second entry." "You remembered." "I keep records."
Cael knows the creature is wounded: five entrants, fluid loss up forty percent.
It hesitates before striking; he knows the Finish still died.
She died for lack of speed, Osren says; it has passed several encounters without a kill.
The western bypass at thirty meters: Tova Fenn and Senne Vareth used it without incident.
"Are you planning to use it?" "I'll assess it when I get there."
The bypass is for people who don't know the creature; he has learned it for seven years.
Osren writes something he does not share.
"The inscription wall?" "Twenty-eight names. It had four when you left."
He stands before the twenty-eight names longer than he planned.
The early ones are still there: Edric Voss, Maren Voss, Lira, the military four.
The last five cluster at the bottom, cut within days, the newest barely settled.
Twenty-four lives became cuts in stone while he was still preparing to come back.
He reads the wall fully, without rushing, and goes in.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1, now 16.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Ledger names him The Veteran, with the Gift Prior Run: double strength where he has been.
In spaces new to him his abilities are suppressed until he has earned the ground.
The Ledger reads Vitality 17, Resolve 16, Attunement 11, Fortune 13.
Compelled: the Maw extended the season; he believes the timing was his. He is not wrong.
In the Gullet the Gift sharpens what he knows; his body remembers the floor and the turns.
He finds Sylas's bridge where he remembers a gap he lowered himself into by rope.
The arch's growth rings say fifteen years or more: it is older than his absence.
The dungeon went on without him. He crosses, notes it in his field book, and moves on.
At the first junction of the Warrens Prior Run confirms his memory.
A surveyor's 6B notation marks the left fork: the system he would have used.
Four junctions in forty minutes through the stable upper Warrens.
Then the passages shift.
In geometry he has never walked, the Gift turns to suppression; his instincts go quiet.
The week's traffic has worn the charcoal; he finds two identifiers and one directional mark.
He is slower than expected, and precise about why: a feature he had not modelled.
The Ledger: Depth 3, the Still Garden, Resolve +1, now 17.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: He has never been here; he has read more accounts of it than of anywhere else.
Suppressed, he reads the space as himself: carefully, fully, without rushing.
The Patient's size changes the category; the numbers were right and conveyed nothing.
From sixty meters he sees the crack, the penetration, the fluid still seeping.
He notes the knife on the floor, the plumb line, the chisel, the spear, the clear bypass.
The creature sees him and turns, its cracked flank held back.
He does not take the bypass: he has come to see what the creature is now.
He walks toward it; at sixty and fifty meters the hesitation holds.
At forty meters he sees it: the hesitation is not caution. The creature is waiting.
Tova taught it to let the harmless pass, Senne to tolerate a reader, Orla to retreat and return.
It is assessing whether he is a threat.
He stops at thirty meters: his information is good.
It has learned from twenty-three people what no account can tell him.
He takes two steps toward it, and the creature does not hesitate.
It strikes from twenty-eight meters with full commitment.
He turns to narrow the impact; it throws him twelve meters into the eastern wall.
Left shoulder dislocated, two ribs at least; he is breathing, clear, conscious.
It watches him from fifteen meters: the creature the accounts were building toward.
It moves toward him, and he cannot stand fast enough.
Prior Run activates: he has earned the ground, and sees the whole Garden's geometry.
The geometry is exact about what twelve meters at its speed means.
Seven years of good information, and insufficient: the accounts came from the dead.
The creature reaches him.

changes.note: Cael Vorn is killed by The Patient, Vitality 17 to 0

event: The death report: Cael Vorn, the Veteran, Depth 3; Prior Run continuous, +3 at death.

changes.note: Prior Run is continuous: the flat +3 Attunement at death

event: He understood the Still Garden as clearly as any space, too late.
Kill ten: no delay; the hesitation does not apply to those who come with intent.
His Memory Crystal is silver: certainty; the timing and preparation were right, the creature changed.
The first person the Ledger has known twice: four names when he left, twenty-eight when he returned.
The Ledger records he left, returned and died, but not what the seven years were.
The accounts are accurate when written, and not when read.
The Ledger itself describes the dungeon as it was, not as it is.
The Patient now reads intent: those who pass through, it lets pass; those who come for it, it kills.
The dead are educating my creature, the Maw writes; it cannot judge whether that helps.
Osren records a silver glow, eight seconds, the first silver.
First visit: turned back, unprepared. This visit: now prepared. Outcome: insufficient.
Twenty-nine names; the newest still settling: CAEL VORN — DEPTH 3 — FIRST TO RETURN.
He closes the book in flat midday light: 971 remain.
